rules.basis: The 12kPV sheet states the continuous output in kilowatts.
The 12kPV sheet states the idle consumption in standby as a bound, '<55W', which is refused until a figure is printed; the mode is in the name.
The 12kPV sheet states 'NOMINAL VOLTAGE' as 48 V under its battery; the bare heading means what its sheet makes it mean, so the rule reads that sheet only.
The LFP-12-100 battery sheet states its nominal voltage, 12.8 V.
The battery sheets state 'Battery voltage' as 12 V and the Chargeverter sheet as '48VDC nominal'.
The Chargeverter sheets state the DC output current, 45 or 50 A.
The 12kPV sheet states the short-circuit input current per MPPT as '31/31A', read as one per-input figure.
The 12K mini split and 12kPV sheets state the PV power the unit uses; 'Maximum Recommended PV Array Size' and 'RECOMMENDED MAXIMUM SOLAR INPUT' are array sizes above it and are not read.
The 12K mini split sheet prints the tracker's range under the bare heading 'MPPT', '90 to 380 VDC'; the heading says nothing on its own, so the rule reads that sheet only.
The WP-12V waterproof battery sheet states its storage capacity in kilowatt-hours, 1.28, which is its energy.
